_meta.purpose: Manually-maintained snapshot of real Anthropic model pricing, used by scripts/check-price-table-drift.mjs to detect when packages/core/src/enforce/budget/claude-transcript.ts's DEFAULT_PRICE_TABLE has drifted from what the vendor actually charges.
_meta.unit: USD per million tokens (MTok); cacheWritePerMTok is the 5-minute cache-write rate (the same duration DEFAULT_PRICE_TABLE's own fallback approximates)
_meta.update_procedure: No live fetch. A human re-checks the source URL above against this file's `models` object and hand-edits any changed number, on some periodic cadence this repo does not yet automate. See the script's own header comment for why a live fetch isn't wired in here.
_meta.deliberately_incomplete: Only models whose EXACT dated model-ID string (the form a real Claude Code transcript emits, e.g. 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001') is confirmed are listed below. Sonnet 5 and Opus 5 pricing tiers are public, but this repo has no confirmed dated-ID string for them yet (only the short alias 'claude-sonnet-5', which claude-transcript.ts's own tests document as NOT a valid lookup key) — adding a guessed dated ID here would recreate exactly the guessing DEFAULT_PRICE_TABLE's exact-match design exists to prevent. Add a model only once its real dated ID has been observed in a live transcript or confirmed from Anthropic's own model list.
